subject: ggvis doesn't appear in shiny with UI dynamic

messages.author: 76e101ce83bfedbb
messages.subject: ggvis doesn't appear in shiny with UI dynamic
parts:
Hi

i am building a app and i am using a UI dynamic according to a menu i made the ggvis plot and the first time ggvis plot appears correctly but when i change the UI the ggvis plot doesn't appear

UI.R
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Test"),
  sidebarPanel(    
    selectInput(inputId = "plots",
                label = "select master",
                choices = c("p1",
                            "p1&p2",
                            "p1&p2&p3"),
                selected = "1")),
    
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput('gg')  
  )
))

SERVER.R

library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {  
  
    output$gg<-renderUI({
    if(input$plots=="p1"){
      list(
      textOutput("label1"),
      ggvisOutput("plot1")
      )
    }else{if(input$plots=="p1&p2"){
      list(
      textOutput("label1"),
      ggvisOutput("plot1"),
      textOutput("label2"),
      plotOutput("plot2")
      )
    }else{
      list(
        textOutput("label1"),
        ggvisOutput("plot1"),
        textOutput("label2"),
        plotOutput("plot2"),
        textOutput("label3"),
        plotOutput("plot3")
      )  
    }}
  })
    
 mtcars %>%
    ggvis(~mpg, ~disp) %>% 
    layer_points( ) %>% 
    set_options(width=800) %>% 
    bind_shiny('plot1')
 
output$plot2<-renderPlot({
ggplot(data=mtcars,aes(x=wt,y=disp))+geom_point(color="red")  
}) 
 
output$plot3<-renderPlot({
  ggplot(data=mtcars,aes(x=cyl,y=disp))+geom_point(color="blue")  
}) 

output$label1<-renderText({"GGVIS PLOT 1"})
output$label2<-renderText({"GGPLOT 2"})
output$label3<-renderText({"GGPLOT 3"})
  
})

In this example my dynamic UI is according to the menu, but when i change the UI in the menu options, the ggvis Plot doesn't update, if i use ggplot and renderPlot my app works correctly

i appreciate your help

Thanks

Natalia
